title: ATV Cover Size 3XL – 256 × 110 × 120 cm, Black
seo_description: ATV cover in size 3XL, 256 × 110 × 120 cm, black. Covers the vehicle completely between rides. Measure your ATV before you order.
descriptionHtml:
Dust and debris settle while the ATV sits still

Between rides the ATV is parked outdoors or in the garage – leaves, dust and debris settle on the paint day after day, without you doing anything about it.

A cover in the right size – 3XL, 256 × 110 × 120 cm

The black cover goes over the whole ATV between rides and covers the vehicle in its full length, width and height. Size 3XL (256 × 110 × 120 cm) is the only size sold – measure your ATV before you order.

Features

  • Debris settles on the cover, not on the paint – a full-coverage cover goes straight over the whole ATV.
  • Covers the ATV in its full shape – 256 cm long, 110 cm wide and 120 cm high in size 3XL.
  • Available in one size only: 3XL – measure your ATV against 256 × 110 × 120 cm before you order.
  • Discreet in the garage – all black instead of a brightly colored tarp.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
